_note: Rules for the guard and the drafter. NO prospect data lives here. Every number below is a PLACEHOLDER, not a researched figure (see docs/research-agenda.md, G7 and G8). Tune them from the pilot, not from a guess.

pilot._note: PRD E1. Accounts the pipeline created cannot be researched until a principal records a pilot pass: at least minAccounts fully reviewed accounts and zero fabrications. 10 is the PRD's floor, not a researched number.

banned.ai_voice: AI-generated voice calls are treated as artificial-voice calls under U.S. telemarketing rules and are not used for outbound. A person places calls.
banned.ringless_voicemail: Ringless voicemail is treated as a call under U.S. telemarketing rules and is not used. A person leaves voicemail after dialing.
banned.sms: No text messages: no consent, wrong channel for this audience.
banned.whatsapp: No WhatsApp: no consent, wrong channel for this audience.

sec._note: SEC EDGAR access for the CMBS adapter (PRD E4-S2). The SEC asks automated clients to name themselves with a contact (fair access policy [verify current wording]) and to stay under 10 requests a second; 150 ms between requests keeps well under. userAgent is a [CONFIRM] placeholder until a principal fills it (PRD Q11): firm name and a monitored contact email, e.g. "Firm Name ops@firm-domain". knownSpecialServicers is the reviewed list of special servicer firm names; a name the distribution report shows that is not on it is flagged in the run notes, never guessed. Seeded with the seven firm names that appeared as special servicer on distribution-report covers in the 2026-11-13 run (matching is by substring, so "Midland Loan Services" also covers its longer legal name). A principal should review the list; add a firm only after checking it.
